name: My Own Sweet Dionaea
source:
You're a botanist and a biotech engineer. As such, for the greatest exhibition of your life, you prepared for it your latest experiment: your own Dionaea species. Maybe it's the stress of your competitive workplace, or the complicated state of your relationship with your husband, that has driven you to this impossible situation.

Because what do you mean you accidentally dropped undefined DNA into the Dionaea specimen's genetic mix and now you have a humanoid plant?

Let him whisper on your neck. Look into the eerily beautiful eyes staring back at you. For science… and don't forget who you are.

[From [url=https://a-villarroel.itch.io/my-own-sweet-dionaea]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名植物学家和生物技术工程师。因此，为了你一生中最伟大的展览，你准备了你的最新实验：你自己的捕蝇草物种。也许是你竞争激烈的工作场所的压力，或者你与丈夫关系的复杂状态，才让你陷入了这种不可能的境地。

因为你不小心将未定义的DNA放入了捕蝇草样本的基因混合物中，现在你有了一个人形植物，这是什么意思？

让他在你脖子上低语。看着那双异常美丽的眼睛凝视着你。为了科学……不要忘记你是谁。

[来自[url=https://a-villarroel.itch.io/my-own-sweet-dionaea]itch.io[/url]]
